anomalies.description: A man in a white shirt engages in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat with an opponent holding a knife; the sequence shows grappling, striking, and the knife being used or threatened, culminating in the opponent receiving facial trauma.; A sustained multi-person physical fight in a dimly lit, cluttered indoor space. One man in a white tank top (later revealed with a red stain on his chest) engages multiple opponents using punches, kicks, and improvised weapons (e.g., a metal rod). The combat is dynamic and mutual, with participants actively attacking and defending.

At the start of the sequence, the man in the white t-shirt is shown delivering a forceful blow to an opponent whose face is heavily bloodied and appears incapacitated, suggesting an attack on a helpless victim in that specific moment before the broader fight escalates.
The same man in the white shirt fights multiple opponents in a cluttered indoor space, using kicks and strikes; at least two adversaries are visibly engaged and one is knocked down.

A man in a brown jacket lies on the ground (visible in f0, f4, f5, f10, f11) while others continue fighting around him; he appears helpless and is not actively participating, suggesting he is being abused or neglected during the ongoing fight.

A multi-person melee fight occurs in a dimly lit workshop; one man in a white tank top actively engages multiple opponents with hand-to-hand combat and improvised weapons, while another man in a brown jacket is knocked to the ground and remains incapacitated.

A man in a white tank top engages in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat with an opponent, delivering rapid punches and blocks in a cluttered workshop setting.; The same man in the white shirt uses a fiery forge or molten metal as part of the fight, striking an opponent who is thrown backward through sparks and smoke near the fire source.; The fight continues with dynamic acrobatic maneuvers: the protagonist climbs scaffolding while being attacked, then counters with kicks and grappling on elevated platforms, culminating in a close-range struggle near a red support pole.; A man in a white shirt engages in close-quarters combat with an opponent, delivering multiple strikes including a high kick and a downward strike with a wooden object, resulting in the opponent being knocked down amidst sparks and fire.
A sudden, violent explosion erupts from a metal container near a fire pit; sparks and debris are violently ejected, and a person is thrown backward by the blast force.

A man in dark clothing performs an acrobatic leap over a red altar while another person is visible on a platform above; the motion and context suggest a choreographed fight sequence.; The man in the white shirt is seen moving rapidly through the cluttered space, engaging or evading multiple opponents in a chaotic melee; background figures are also fighting, suggesting ongoing group combat.; Two men engage in close-quarters combat: one in a white shirt executes a high kick that connects with the opponent, who is thrown backward into a burning barrel, causing flames to erupt around him.

The same man in the white shirt performs an acrobatic leap from a high platform onto a lower area where adversaries are present, indicating a continuation of the fight sequence in a multi-level environment.
A man in a white tank top wields a long metal pipe as a weapon and swings it at an opponent in a brown jacket; sparks fly upon impact, indicating a forceful strike in a melee exchange.
Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat; one is heavily bloodied (visible on face and chest in f0–f1) and struck repeatedly, including a visible punch to the face at f7.
Two men engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat: the man in white throws a punch while the man in brown blocks and counters; they grapple and lift each other off the ground.
The protagonist grabs a hanging chain and lifts an opponent off the ground in a dynamic aerial takedown, demonstrating active combat engagement.

The man in white executes a high kick or throw, launching the man in brown into the air; the airborne motion is captured across frames as he flips mid-air before impact.; The opponent is thrown through the air (f12–f13), lands hard on the floor (f14), and the protagonist collapses afterward (f15), consistent with the aftermath of intense mutual combat.; Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat in a dusty industrial space; one man (in white shirt) is on the ground, grappling and striking the other (in brown jacket), who is also downed and bleeding.

After being knocked down, the man in brown lies incapacitated on the floor with visible facial injuries; the man in white repeatedly strikes him while he is helpless, including punching his head and grabbing his hair/face (frames f11–f14).
A bright flash and expanding fireball erupts in the background at 72.5s, consistent with a sudden explosion; dust and debris are visibly displaced.
After the initial fight, the man in the white shirt continues to strike the incapacitated opponent lying on the ground, indicating abuse of a helpless victim.
